prompt: After Edward II, who was the next English monarch to have been born outside of England?
answer: **Richard II** was the next English monarch after Edward II to be born outside England. He was born at **Bordeaux, in the Duchy of Aquitaine (modern-day France), in 1367**. Edward III, who succeeded Edward II, was born at Windsor, England.
